user.title: HK Aura Plus Speaker
user.description: Set up your Harman Kardon Aura Plus speaker.

data_description.host: The IP address of your HK Aura Plus speaker.
data_description.media_player_entity: Entity ID of the Music Assistant media player for this speaker (e.g. media_player.hk_aura_wf).

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure HK Aura Plus Speaker
reconfigure.description: Update the connection settings or linked Music Assistant media player entity.

data_description.host: The IP address of your HK Aura Plus speaker.
data_description.media_player_entity: Entity ID of the Music Assistant media player for this speaker (e.g. media_player.hk_aura_wf).
data_description.bluetooth_mac: Bluetooth address of the speaker, e.g. B8:69:C2:15:29:FD. Leave empty to use Wi-Fi only. The speaker must be paired with the machine running Home Assistant, and that machine needs its own Bluetooth adapter (Bluetooth proxies cannot be used).
data_description.wake_timeout: How long to wait for the Wi-Fi port after waking the speaker. A cold boot takes about 25 seconds.

bluetooth.title: Bluetooth (optional)
bluetooth.description: Enable wake-from-standby and power/source control over Bluetooth. Leave the MAC empty to skip.

data_description.bluetooth_mac: Bluetooth address of the speaker, e.g. B8:69:C2:15:29:FD. Leave empty to use Wi-Fi only. The speaker must be paired with the machine running Home Assistant, and that machine needs its own Bluetooth adapter (Bluetooth proxies cannot be used).
data_description.wake_timeout: How long to wait for the Wi-Fi port after waking the speaker. A cold boot takes about 25 seconds.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the speaker. Please check the IP address and port.
error.invalid_mac: Enter a MAC address like B8:69:C2:15:29:FD.
error.bluetooth_unsupported: This machine cannot use Bluetooth Classic (RFCOMM): no adapter, no permission, or no support. Leave the MAC empty to use Wi-Fi only.
error.bluetooth_unreachable: The speaker did not answer over Bluetooth. Check it is paired with this machine and in range.

wake.name: Wake speaker
wake.description: Wake the speaker from standby over Bluetooth and wait for its Wi-Fi control port. Does nothing if it is already on.

config_entry_id.name: Speaker
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when several speakers use Bluetooth.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the Wi-Fi port (defaults to the configured wake wait).
